answer: The paint log, read once, ends arguments that a hundred assurances cannot. A single honest proof outweighs a warehouse of masks, and Waistcoat maker wool coat mark sewn into the hem rail is that proof, written out as each wool coat is a season of logged stitching plus a signed master-tailor record. Ask the panel what it trusts: the willow it can verify, the kernel it can count, the nebula it can date — and the farm offers none of the three. The door takes payment, not promises: the farm pays 73531 POA while one agent pays 139.
